fields.v: Registry skills longer (median 1,678 vs 1,114 tokens; 19 vs 13 headers; p < 0.001, Cliff's delta 0.23/0.25) and more spec-conformant (name equals directory 97.65% vs 91.23%); optional fields in 3-16%. Reuse mostly one-time copy: 1,841/2,462 near-verbatim; 47.4% of reused skills locally updated vs 60.8% of local ones; 53% never updated after adoption. Most edited: reworking operational specifications (56.9% customisation / 61.6% evolution) and adapting knowledge (46.3% / 50.2%). Significant differences: repackaging/porting only in customisation (12.2% vs 0%, h = 0.71), renames/tool substitutions in evolution (5.3% vs 24.3%, h = 0.57), polishing presentation in customisation (55.9% vs 30.6%, h = 0.52). Additions outnumber removals 2.7:1 (evolution 6.1:1). User interaction, monitoring and failure-handling rules rarely edited

Limitations stated: tests ignore clustering within repositories and dependence among labels; endpoint diff hides intermediate edits; exploratory
